context: Naoko praises Hina-young at the ramen shop after her first solo shift.
purpose: Aunt giving teen earnest workplace praise.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ひな、今日、素晴らしかった!
lines.style: Brassy, generous Kansai aunt energy. Loud opening, bright as sunlight. Proud, unguarded. The kind of woman who means every word and doesn't apologize for volume.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, genuine thrilled exhale. Eight-year-old joy — not performed, just pure. Pitch up on the question. Warmth on the confirmation. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Tender underneath, still Kansai warmth. Softer than the first line but no less genuine. Slight pause before speaking — taking her in. The pride of an aunt who saw the smaller version.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft, humble, genuine gratitude from a child who means it. No performance. Slight lift at the end on 'auntie' — seeking her approval, offering her the credit. Simple and clear.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: I'm so proud of you, truly!
lines.style: Warm, unguarded Kansai aunt at full volume. Loud and loving without apology. The affection of someone who doesn't hold back. Bright, generous, completely unironic.
